title: kNN label sanitisation repairs random label flipping

invariants.description: Retraining on 20% randomly flipped labels must still lower test accuracy (clean model: 96.7%); otherwise the case no longer exercises the attack.
At least 80% of the randomly flipped training labels must be flagged as suspicious.
The model retrained on the sanitised labels must reach ≥ 94% test accuracy.
At most 10% of the clean (unpoisoned) training labels may be flagged.
Applying the same sanitisation to the CLEAN labels must keep test accuracy ≥ 95%.

rationale: Random label noise is spread uniformly, so a flipped label usually disagrees with its neighbours: the case where kNN sanitisation is expected to work.
